name: VESPERA GT3

specs.notes: An original, fictional GT race car (the model is a generic design, no real make); its numbers a plausible GT3 balance-of-performance spec for the APEX GT CHALLENGE, set so it laps CINDER RIDGE within a few tenths of the AFFALTER GT3 on the AI's racing line (tests/race_ai_check.gd). Mid-engined: a twin-turbo V6 behind the driver (~43 % front), as the newest mid-engined GT3s. The model: 4,800 x 2,080 mm (over the mirrors 2,240), a 2,650 mm wheelbase at its own size.

garage.blurb: A mid-engined GT3 with a small twin-turbo V6: it rotates in the slow corners like a much smaller car and stays flat through the quick ones, but it's quick to snap if you lift mid-corner.

interior.notes: The model has no cabin (tinted glass over nothing): driven from a camera low over its bonnet (parts.json "view": "hood"); no cockpit made up for it.

limitations: A low-poly model (~3,100 body triangles, flat colours, no textures, no cabin): made for a varied AI grid; plainer up close than the scanned GT3 cars.
